title: Manager Software Engineering
description:
Job Summary Manager Software Engineering Are you passionate about leading engineering teams that build high-volume production systems using modern technologies Would you like to combine Java, Springboot and Gen AI experience with technical leadership in the healthcare space About the Role You will lead and develop an engineering team delivering production systems and high-volume applications, while remaining close enough to the technology to contribute when needed. You will work across Engineering, Product, and Design, helping the team deliver commitments, solve complex technical challenges, and build expertise in Java, Springboot and Gen AI. About the Team We organize our engineering teams into collaborative Squads that bring together Software Engineers, Quality Engineers, Product Managers, and Engineering Leaders to build and deliver customer-focused solutions. Our teams value continuous learning, innovation, inclusivity, and shared ownership. We encourage engineers to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, mentor others, and help shape the future of our products and platforms. Responsibilities Empower, guide, and maximize a team of mission-driven engineers to solve challenging problems in the aviation industry by building using cutting-edge technology. Collaborate with Engineering leadership and cross-functional partners (including Product, Design, Marketing) to establish roadmaps and strategy that help serve and grow the business and represent engineering-driven considerations to ensure all stakeholder groups are aligned on company priorities, expectations, and contingencies. Contribute to technical development and discussions as necessary to ensure the team is building technology that scales and meets the business needs by Providing both ongoing support and mentorship to direct reports, strategically aligning their skills, interests, and career aspirations with business needs; defining, streamlining, and guiding the projects they work on; and both initiating and inviting conversations around performance, development, and morale Deliver results in the fast-paced environment of a growing startup while always treating team members and colleagues with empathy & humanity Successfully partner and lead resources in solving complex business needs. Perform reviews to ensure enterprise and architectural standards and processes are followed. Complete management responsibilities to include performance management, hiring and coaching of staff, and resource planning. Carry out management responsibilities in accordance with the organization s policies, procedures, and applicable laws. Responsibilities include interviewing, hiring, and training employees; planning, assigning, and directing work; appraising performance; rewarding and disciplining employees; and addressing complaints and resolving problems. Ensure all staff is provided with training and resources needed to perform their jobs to the most outstanding degree possible. Ensure all staff is provided with frequent feedback and coaching in order to meet and exceed individual and team performance goals consistently. Manage and encourage new ideas from staff to foster improvements through innovations. Empower the staff to be accountable and responsible for their own actions and decisions. All other duties as assigned. Requirements Experience with technologies mainly focused on Java and Springboot background in addition to Gen AI exposure. Background in the healthcare space or related field is an added advantage with atleast 4+ years of team lead or engineering management experience with Proven track record of effectively developing direct reports through continual feedback and goal-setting and growing them through the ranks of an engineering organization. Advanced understanding of modern software development practices and methodologies, and the ability to roll up your sleeves and contribute when necessary Experience directly working on or managing teams working on production systems and high-volume applications, successfully navigating the relationship between Engineering, Product, and Design teams with collaboration, mentoring, learning from other engineers, and treating colleagues with empathy and respect. Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with all stakeholders, internal drive to problem-solve, both creatively and pragmatically to scope, prioritize, and deliver on project commitments and learn new technologies quickly. Strong skills in setting, communicating, implementing, and achieving business objectives and goals through the direct management of others. Strong organization/project planning, time management, and change management skills across multiple functional groups and departments, and strong delegation skills involving prioritizing and reprioritizing projects and managing projects of various size and complexity. Advanced problem-solving experience involving leading teams in identifying, researching, and coordinating the resources necessary to effectively troubleshoot/diagnose complex project issues; prior success extracting/translating findings into alternatives/solutions; and identifying risks/impacts and schedule adjustments to facilitate management decision-making.

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
Job_Description":" We are looking for a highly skilled Senior Playwright Automation Engineer to lead automation strategy, 
 build scalable frameworks and drive quality excellence across our products. If you are passionate about modern automation engineering and enjoy solving complex quality challenges, this role is for you. 
 
 
 Key Responsibilities 
 
 Architect and enhance scalable automation frameworks using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript/Python). 
 
 Develop automated tests for UI, API, cross-browser, and cross-platform scenarios. 
 
 Implement advanced features: network mocking, tracing, visual validation, test data management. 
 
 Integrate Playwright test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps). 
 
 Evaluate new tools and frameworks to improve automation efficiency and reliability. 
 
 Perform pull request (PR) reviews, enforce coding standards, and support clean code practices. 
 
 Manage Git workflows, including branching, merging, and resolving conflicts. 
 
 Lead automation initiatives across multiple teams/projects. 
 
 Collaborate with Developers, Product Owners, and QA teams to ensure high test coverage. 
 
 Participate in sprint planning, design discussions, and risk assessments. 
 
 
 Required Skills & Experience 
 
 8+ years in QA automation, including 5+ years hands-on Playwright expertise. 
 
 Strong coding experience in TypeScript/JavaScript/Python. 
 
 Deep understanding of HTML, DOM, CSS, JavaScript events, REST APIs. 
 
 Expertise in Page Object Model (POM), BDD/TDD, and modern test design. 
 
 Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills. 
 
 Experience managing large test suites and reducing test flakiness. 
 
 Hands-on experience with Git, branching strategies, and CI/CD tools. 
 
 
 Nice to Have 
 
 Knowledge of security, accessibility, or performance testing. 
 
 Experience with cloud testing platforms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, LambdaTest). 
 
 Familiarity with Docker or containerized test execution. 
 
 
 Soft Skills 
 
 Strong communication and leadership presence. 
 
 Ability to lead technical discussions and influence QA strategy. 
 
 Experience mentoring junior and mid-level automation engineers.

title: C# SDET QA
description:
C# SDET QA - Job Description 
 Job Title: C# SDET QA
 Location: Mumbai
 Experience Level: 7+ Years 
 Key Responsibilities: The QA Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing robust automation frameworks and enhancing existing test automation solutions to support evolving business and technology needs. Executes QA activities across multiple projects, ensuring high-quality software delivery through well-structured, maintainable and efficient test automation practices. Drives quality standards, promotes best practices, and collaborates closely with development and product teams to deliver reliable and scalable solutions. 
 Required Experience: 5+ years experience as a QA Engineer specialising in Test Automation using C# programming language, delivering high-quality, scalable and maintainable automated testing solutions. Strong experience working in Agile environments (Scrum/Kanban) using tools such as Azure DevOps and Jira, actively contributing to sprint ceremonies and continuous improvement practices. Proven ability to design and build automation frameworks from scratch, covering API automation (RestSharp) and UI automation (Selenium / Playwright) using BDD practices with Reqnroll. Experience implementing and maintaining CI/CD pipelines to enable automated test execution as part of continuous integration and delivery processes. Hands-on experience in Non-Functional Testing, ensuring system reliability, performance and stability. Strong experience in API testing, including building Postman collections and validating responses using JavaScript. Experience using application monitoring and observability tools such as Application Insights, Kibana or similar platforms to analyse system behaviour and support issue investigation. Skilled in developing End-to-End, Integration and Contract tests to ensure comprehensive test coverage across complex systems. Proficient in SQL, writing complex queries and performing data validation and data integration testing. Experience generating automated test reports and dashboards using tools such as Extent Reports and SpecFlow Living Documentation to provide clear quality insights to stakeholders. Demonstrated experience mentoring QA engineers, promoting automation best practices, and conducting code reviews to maintain high engineering standards. Strong collaboration with Business Analysts and Developers to refine requirements, define acceptance criteria, and actively participate in Three Amigos sessions to ensure shared understanding and quality from the early stages of development. A proactive, accountable and professional team player, committed to fostering a positive and collaborative team environment. Works effectively across cross-functional teams, takes ownership of deliverables, and contributes to collective team success rather than operating in isolation. 
 Essential skills: Strong working knowledge of Terraform for infrastructure provisioning and management within modern cloud environments. Experience testing and supporting applications built on Microsoft Azure, including Azure Functions and Azure Web Applications. Solid understanding of event-driven and messaging architectures, with experience working with Azure Service Bus and Azure Event Hub. Experience working with Microsoft Dynamics 365, including familiarity with solution lifecycle management, deployments, and environment management. Proficiency in working with applications developed using .NET (including .NET 10) within modern enterprise architectures. 
 Desired Experience: The ideal candidate will have financial services experience in the private equity, infrastructure & real assets or private debt space. However, this is not a stringent requirement. 
 Desired skills: Exposure to Databricks platform, including working with data pipelines, analytics workflows, or testing data-driven applications within cloud-based data environments. Experience or familiarity with AI/ML-enabled systems, including developing or testing AI agents, and validating AI-driven features and workflows. Knowledge of observability and monitoring practices for AI systems, using tools or frameworks that support AI model behaviour monitoring, performance validation, and reliability testing. Experience working with private markets or financial services platforms, such as eFront or similar private equity / investment management systems.
